theorems.name: Submission.critical_set_small_ball_covers_of_isCompact
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (V Q : Set (Rn (m + k))) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G V → IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ V → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ (s : Finset (Rn (m + k))) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 2 * r ≤ δ ∧ {x | x ∈ Q ∧ ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G x)} ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ s, closedBall x r ∧ ∑ x ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) * volume (G '' closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
